name: Completion Framework
definition: A framework dedicated to repairing and complementing incomplete point clouds by using two encoders to produce separate latent representations for existing and missing parts, which are concatenated and decoded to output NeRF weights.
summary: The Completion Framework repairs incomplete point clouds by encoding existing and missing parts into separate latent representations, which are concatenated and decoded to output NeRF weights for generating complete, colored 3D scenes.
